scope: Prospective highest-supported reasoning tier and exact native wire form for all 74 identities in MODEL-TEST-PLAN.oauth-first.json. Prep only: no inference, no qualification calls, no Vercel funding probes were made; sources are public docs/catalogs fetched read-only.
routing_policy: GPT -> Codex OAuth Responses; Claude -> Anthropic OAuth Messages; non-OAuth -> OpenCode Go when exact model native-qualified, else Vercel (unfunded, hold). NVIDIA NIM (provider nim, chat, https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1, key env NVIDIA_NIM_API_KEY) entries added for 8 models per Main. One entry per (provider, model).

tier_semantics.effort levels: highest documented level for the exact model on that route, never below the legacy initial tier unless the legacy tier was not a real control on that model (noted per entry)
tier_semantics.thinking-on: route control is a boolean thinking switch only (NIM chat_template_kwargs); switched on = highest
tier_semantics.thinking-budget: budget-only thinking; budget_tokens = run_output_cap - 16384 reserve (reserve chosen as answer room for a bash tool call writing a module/script)
tier_semantics.none-available: route exposes no reasoning control; reasoning_mode says whether the model is non-reasoning or thinks by default (always-on/default-on), in which case omitting reasoning fields is already the highest setting
tier_semantics.blocked-unknown: route-level control or model identity undocumented; candidate_reasoning_if_unblocked given where a vendor form exists

run_output_cap_rule: run_output_cap = model documented max output clamped to the route provider/catalog max (min of credible values); a catalog max_tokens equal to the context window is not treated as an output limit when a vendor/first-party value exists. M1 (2026-10-01, methodology-audit.md): when the documented output limit is not separate from the context window (model_max_output_tokens >= 95% of context_window), run_output_cap = min(model_max_output_tokens, context_window // 2), so prompt + max_tokens stays inside the window as the conversation grows. Applied to: codex_oauth/gpt-oss-120b 131072->65536, go/grok-4.6 500000->250000, go/grok-4.7 500000->250000, go/kimi-k2.7-code 262144->131072, vercel/moonshotai/kimi-k2.6 262000->131000, vercel/spacexai/grok-4.5 500000->250000, vercel/thinkingmachines/inkling 256000->128000, vercel/mistral/mistral-medium-3.5 256000->131072, vercel/stepfun/step-3.7-flash 256000->128000. Thinking budgets stay below the cap (opus-4-5 47616 < 64000; qwen3.7-plus 49152 < 65536). Each entry records limits.run_output_cap_source. Same number is written into generation max_tokens/max_output_tokens. Checked go/hy3: cap 128000 = context 256000 // 2 already meets the rule (its max_input_tokens 192000 is the provider's own input bound). M3 probe fallback (2026-10-01 qualification, qualification-results.json): nim/chat failed the long-generation probe (HTTP 504 at ~5 min, all transport retries), so nim/chat run_output_cap > 64000 was lowered to 64000. The other non-Vercel families were inconclusive twice (no single reply above 22k output tokens, no transport errors) and keep their caps: long replies untested, not a transport failure.
